//: The E2E layer's own typecheck. Separate from the root tsconfig because these files run under PLAYWRIGHT (Node), not Bun: they need @types/node rather than bun-types, and the root program deliberately covers only src/ and packages/. `bunx tsc --noEmit -p tests/e2e` is the gate.
// exclude: The unit tests under fixtures/ run under `bun test`, not Playwright, so they import `bun:test` — which this program deliberately does not have in `types`. Those files are transpiled by `bun test` itself, the same as `tests/ci-gates.test.ts`.
